name: io.github.BlackBoxEngineering/agent-envelope-mcp
description: MCP adapter for AgentEnvelope: sovereign verification, hosted decisions, delegates, legitimacy, and mint receipts.

environmentVariables.name: AE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Portal-issued API key. Required only for hosted-governance tools (ae_get_agent, ae_verify_action, ae_authorize_action, ae_get_delegate, ae_check_legitimacy, ae_mint). Sovereign signature and record verification need no key.

environmentVariables.name: AE_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Optional tool exposure mode. Set to readonly to omit ae_mint and expose only verification/query tools.
